identification: Five carded Australian silver sixpences: 1918-M (George V, scarce, weak reverse, hand-annotated card), 1921, 1943-S x2 (San Francisco, KGVI), 1954 (uncirculated, full lustre). Only the 1918-M has any numismatic premium; the rest are common silver.
